createFramework.title: Create New Framework
createFramework.description: Fill in the details below to create a new framework. Click create when you're done.

editFramework.title: Edit Framework
editFramework.description: Update the details for the framework. Click save when you're done.
editFramework.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this framework? This action cannot be undone.
editFramework.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
editFramework.deleteConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the framework, all of its requirements and published versions, and remove it from any organizations currently tracking it.

familyDialog.createDescription: Fill in the details below to create a new framework family. Click create when you're done.
familyDialog.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the family "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
familyDialog.deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

moveFramework.title: Move Framework
moveFramework.description: Pick the frameworks to move, then choose the destination family.

importFramework.title: Import Framework
importFramework.description: Upload a previously exported framework JSON file to import it.
importFramework.chooseFile: Click to select a JSON file
importFramework.chooseDifferent: Click to choose a different file
importFramework.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is 50 MB.
importFramework.unsupportedVersion: Unsupported export format version. Expected version "1".
importFramework.invalidFile: Invalid file: missing framework name or version.
